messages.subject: Project Cedar — signing arrangements
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Alice, Priya,

We're now in execution mode. Ahead of signing on 19 January, Larkmoor will need a board resolution approving entry into the licence — we can provide a short form of minutes (Project_Cedar_BoardMinutes_Larkmoor) if helpful. Verrell are arranging their own authority.

We'll circulate execution versions of the licence and the agreed schedules for e-signature on the 19th. Donna will co-ordinate the signing logistics.

Kind regards,
Elena

Elena Marchetti
Associate
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
This email is confidential and may be legally privileged.

messages.plaintextBody:
All,

I'm pleased to confirm that the Patent and Know-How Licence Agreement was executed by both parties today, 19 January 2026, and the licence is now in effect. We'll circulate a full execution copy and a signed PDF for the files, and a completion bundle to follow.

Congratulations to everyone — a pleasure working with you on Project Cedar.

Elena

--

22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
